depthT1Tolerance: Recess into shaft diameter · tolerance +0.1 / 0 mm
offsetGNote: Face transition · Forms F, G and H only

descriptions.E: For cylindrical surfaces intended for subsequent machining (grinding). The undercut is made only on the shaft diameter; the face remains flat (90°).
descriptions.F: For cylindrical surfaces with a perpendicular face (simultaneous grinding of the shaft and shoulder face).
descriptions.G: Compact cylindrical-face undercut with a 55° entry angle (e.g. for indexable turning inserts).
descriptions.H: Cylindrical-face undercut with a 60° entry and 15° exit angle, used under higher alternating loads.
